before.name: Flippers
before.description: Separate stiff flipper exteriors pivot at the shoulders; no shared triangles stretch across the flanks. Paired strokes are qualitative, not measured thrust or species-fitted joint angles.

before.name: Adult plumage
before.description: Dark head and silver-grey back, pale belly, broad pale-yellow neck patches and a pinkish lower-bill stripe. Fine relief suggests dense feathers; the source museum scan is not a live-animal morphometric fit.

before.name: Feet and support
before.description: Two rounded webbed feet, short exposed tarsi, three forward toes and small claws, beneath a closed feathered rump. Feet trail during swimming. No display ground is included.

after.name: Flippers
after.description: Source feathered flippers have smoothly bound shoulders. Left and right flippers stroke together dorsoventrally underwater; the outer blades stay stiff. Angle and amplitude are authored.

after.name: Adult plumage
after.description: The selected artist feather images are retained. Shorter bill and flipper proportions, paler yellow vertex-color adjustments and a pink lower-bill panel adapt its king-like traits toward an emperor exterior. This is an artist interpretation, not a measured live-animal morphometric fit.

after.name: Feet and support
after.description: The selected source retains two webbed feet, claws and short visible tarsi. Feet alternate support on land and trail while swimming; they are not the main propulsors. No display ground is included.

before.label: Walk
before.description: An eight-second in-place study alternates supported and recovering feet with restrained lateral sway, then returns to standing. Authored joint angles and timing are uncalibrated.
before.evidence: Species-level scientific context; authored exterior posture study
before.timeScale: uncalibrated illustrative display seconds; no biological clock

rendering.reason: External posture and joint movement only; no calibrated kinematics, forces, feather mechanics or complete physiology.

after.label: Walk
after.description: Four short alternating steps with the stance foot held in world space and a modest side-to-side shift. Both feet remain attached beneath the plumage and end supported. Step size, roll and timing are authored; no measured contact forces or gait speed is implied.

after.label: Swim
after.description: Paired shoulder-driven flipper strokes on a streamlined belly-down exterior, both feet trailing. Active cycles use 1.47 Hz, the mean dominant cycle frequency from nine free-ranging emperor penguins in Sato et al. 2010. The authored eight-second demonstration settles into a glide; angles, amplitude and translational speed are not fitted to tracked animals.
